errors.text_span: FI, DK, NL, SE, IE, MT, ES, LU, EE, AT, SI, DE, LT, EU, PT, BE, LV, IT, CZ, CY, HR, HU, SK, PL, EL, BG, RO
errors.evidence: The description provides an incomplete list of the countries shown on the x-axis. It omits 'FR', which is visible on the chart between 'SI' and 'DE'.
The description claims the vertical axis is labeled "DESI значение", but the figure shows no label on the vertical axis.
The description states the vertical axis range goes up to 77, but the axis in the figure clearly extends to 80.

The description incorrectly maps the colors to the categories. According to the legend, 'Човешки капитал' (Human capital) is blue and 'Свързаност' (Connectivity) is red. The description has them reversed.
The values reported for the top two countries are inaccurate. In the figure, FI's value is approximately 70, not 73, and DK's value is also around 70, not 72.
The values reported for the bottom two countries are significantly incorrect. In the figure, RO's value is approximately 29 (below 30), not 43, and BG's value is approximately 39 (below 40), not 45.
The description fails to mention a key visual feature: the bar for BG (Bulgaria) is highlighted with a blue rectangle, indicating a point of focus in the chart.
